title: Trace of the increment machine
statement: Let $M$ be the increment machine on tape $i$, and let $w$ be a Boolean word stored on tape $i$ of a configuration $c$ in the run phase: at every offset from $-1$ through $|w|$, the tape agrees with the word buffer relative to its head position. Suppose $w$ consists of $p$ true bits followed by either no separator or one false bit and then a remaining word $z$. Then for every time $t$, the run from $c$ is the piecewise trace whose forward configuration at time $t$ applies for $t\le p$, whose rewind configuration indexed by $2p+1-t$ applies for $p<t\le2p+1$, and whose completed configuration applies thereafter; the verdict in the rewind and completed phases records whether the optional tail $z$ is present.
